extraction.name: TravelPlanner
extraction.description: A benchmark crafted for evaluating language agents in tool-use and complex planning within multiple constraints. It provides a rich sandbox environment, various tools for accessing nearly four million data records, and 1,225 meticulously curated planning intents and reference plans.
extraction.creator: Jian Xie, Kai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Tinghui Zhu, Renze Lou, Yuandong Tian, Yanghua Xiao, Yu Su
extraction.citeAs: Jian Xie, Kai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Tinghui Zhu, Renze Lou, Yuandong Tian, Yanghua Xiao, Yu Su. TravelPlanner: A Benchmark for Real-World Planning with Language Agents. arXiv:2402.01622v4, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: TravelPlanner provides a rich sandbox environment with around four million data entries crawled from the Internet that can be accessed via six tools. The original data for each tool is sourced from publicly available Internet data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Environment constraints simulate missing data, such as unavailable transportation (no available flight or driving information between two cities) or unavailable attractions (no available attraction information in the queried city).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: FlightSearch data sourced from the Kaggle Flight Status Prediction dataset; DistanceMatrix data from the Google Distance Matrix API; RestaurantSearch data from the Kaggle Zomato Restaurants Dataset; AttractionSearch data from the Google Places API; AccommodationSearch data from the Kaggle Airbnb Open Data Dataset.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: To incorporate 'Price' into the flight dataset, this value is generated by multiplying the 'Distance' by a random factor ranging from 0.2 to 0.5. For 'self-driving' and 'taxi' modes in DistanceMatrix, the 'Price' is calculated by multiplying the 'Distance' by factors of 1 and 0.15, respectively.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The original data is modified, which includes adding, deleting, and altering certain keys and values to suit requirements and avoid data contamination. Items (restaurants, accommodations) are randomly assigned to various cities. Restaurants are randomly categorized under specific cuisines. Accommodations are assigned random room rules.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For FlightSearch, specific fields like 'FlightDate', 'DepTime', 'ArrTime', 'ActualElapsedTime', 'Distance', 'OriginCityName', and 'DestCityName' are included while discarding other values. For RestaurantSearch, 'Restaurant Name' and 'Average Cost' are extracted. For AccommodationSearch, 'NAME', 'room type', 'price', 'minimum nights', 'review rate number', and 'maximum occupancy' are extracted.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: 20 graduate students were invited to meticulously annotate plans for synthesized queries. A plan is deemed eligible only if it meets all constraints outlined in the evaluation script. Annotators were paid an average of $0.80 for each plan. The authors performed a detailed review of every query and plan, rectifying errors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: To ensure challenges, each query's budget was re-calibrated using the costs from corresponding human-annotated plans, replacing initial heuristic-generated budgets which might be too high, thus reducing the number of feasible plans.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: We will release our evaluation scripts to foster innovation and aid the development of new methods.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Some of the data in the TravelPlanner environment is derived from publicly available data on the Internet, and the content involved does not represent the authors' viewpoints.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Everyone's definition of commonsense may be different. The current evaluation criteria are based on the authors' consensus.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The data in the TravelPlanner sandbox is based on 2022. The current evaluation criteria for commonsense are based on the authors' consensus, which may differ from others' definitions.
